decision: No blocking wiring or permission issue found in the additive three-step workflow extension. Remote Actions execution is still required; local validation is not a CI pass.
independent_actions: Read the complete exact workflow and unified diff against the previously reviewed fixed-z extension.
Ran actionlint 1.7.12 on the actual final file; actual exit code 0 and no diagnostics.
Parsed the real audit/train/checker sources with Python AST and matched all required CLI arguments to the new workflow invocations.

Parsed both YAML files and compared existing steps: 13 become 16; the only modified existing steps are checkout sparse paths and frozen runtime preflight. All eight existing numerical/checker entry-point steps remain exactly unchanged.
wiring_findings: Pull-request path trigger, sparse checkout and TWO_LAYER_ROOT include the exact new directory. workflow_dispatch remains available; no push event has been added.

Global permission remains contents:read, checkout actions stay pinned and persist-credentials:false, and no secret is passed to the model. No pull_request_target or workflow write operation is introduced.
Job env contains only supported static values. The earlier runner.temp context defect remains repaired by a run step that uses RUNNER_TEMP and GITHUB_ENV.
Runtime preflight binds the final protocol and checker hashes before installing the unchanged CPU requirements. Model scripts then check all protocol-bound input and source identities.
Audit and training run with set -euo pipefail and no continue-on-error. Their always()/runtime-success conditions preserve independent diagnostic failures rather than overriding them.
The new independent checker requires both new producer outcomes to equal success. A failure in any earlier step still fails the job; successful later checks do not reset failed status.

The three result paths are distinct from all previous outputs and the scripts use create-only output paths. The existing artifact upload preserves results even after ordinary failures; checkout cleanliness is still enforced.

The two-layer checker accepts --financial-root to verify financial source/binary identity, but performs zero financial kernel and zero PyTorch calls. This differs from the retained fixed-z auxiliary checker, which uses its documented same-kernel branch check.

The checker validates four-mode archived Jacobians and the complete history record, but only the first training gradient is independently tied to the audit; it does not replay Adam or recompute all later training gradients.
preserved_historical_correction: The original job.env runner.temp workflow was invalid and had no jobs in the observed remote run. This review applies only to the explicitly repaired and extended final SHA; it does not retroactively validate that original workflow.
limitations: No numerical scripts or financial evaluation were executed by this workflow review.
No remote Actions run or pass is asserted here.
The immutable functional replay is not a new scientific confirmation set, task-quality benchmark or GPU/speed/energy result.
